summary:
This brief reads the fact layer generated at 2026-11-11T11:37:29Z, which is 06:37 ET and 173 minutes before the 09:30 open, so it is a genuine pre-market read. The US cash block is the 2026-11-10 settled close, with SPY at 749.919983. The 11 China A-share names are at the 2026-11-11 close: all 11 last bars are dated 2026-11-11 and the recomputed one-day changes match the published values to 4 decimals. The three mixed baskets and the Korean, Hong Kong, Taiwanese and Japanese legs each sit on their own 2026-11-11 session. Vintage check: Treasury yields and the real rate stop at 2026-11-09, the dollar index and FX at 2026-11-06, credit and the VIX at 2026-11-09, reverse repo at 2026-11-10, and CPI at 2026-09, so the October CPI print released on 2026-11-10 is not in this layer. Commodities are live quotes and crypto is a 24 hour window.

The 2026-11-10 US tape is a broad but shallow decline: 4 of the 22 sector and theme rows rose against 18 falling, a mean of 0.5294 and a median of 0.5914, both to the downside. The bottom is quantum computing 4.2342, the electric vehicle supply chain 2.1165, autonomous driving 1.8019 and data centers 1.3162. The AI hardware complex split inside itself: NVDA fell 5.4738 to 168.889999, down 18.2883 over a week and 26.094 over a month, MU fell 1.0966 to 725.109985, while AVGO rose 3.9126, AMD rose 1.3036 and TSLA rose 0.4576. That is rotation out of the largest single weight, not a uniform de-rating of the group.

Two rows must not be read as US prints. The memory row at 4.4664 is the 2026-11-11 Korean session, not a US memory move: only 2 of its 8 legs hold both bars, SK Hynix at 5.363 and Samsung Electronics at 3.5696, which average 4.4663, and MU at 1.0966 is excluded outright. consumer_electronics at 0.7135 is the same form on 2 of 10 legs, 1810.HK down 1.634 and 2317.TW up 0.207, and robotics at 0.6915 rests on a single leg, 6861.T up 0.6915. Any sentence that calls 4.4664 a US memory rally is wrong.

China was the strong side of the session. All 11 A-share names closed higher on 2026-11-11, a mean of 5.0545 and a median of 5.2067, and the storage and packaging chain led: 300223.SZ at 7.2575, 688525.SH at 6.9462, 001309.SZ at 6.6082 and 603986.SH at 6.1537, with 000021.SZ the laggard but still at 2.9751. This is the opposite sign to the US memory read and it is consistent with the storage price-hike story in the news feed.

Total risk is 69.11, still high_risk, and the move from the 2026-11-10 row at 69.14 is 0.03 to the downside. The decomposition is small and fully attributable: macro added 0.172 as the 2026-11-09 yield close entered the model, with the 2s10s curve narrowing to 0.32 from 0.35, the real rate rising to 2.66 from 2.63 and the ten year to 4.88 from 4.86; equity structure took back 0.180 as breadth improved to 0.3226 from 0.3097 and the new low ratio fell to 0.0382; trend took 0.016; volatility and cross-asset were flat. The regime is risk_off and only the breadth limb supports it: 0.3226 is below the 0.35 gate while VIX at 19.92 is nowhere near 28.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 75.0 is the largest single input, 6 of 8 legs firing, worth 11.25 points after the 0.8 proxy discount. On: SPY down 0.368, the dollar index at 121.8803, the real rate at 2.66, bitcoin down 0.27387 on a 24 hour window, small cap relative strength at 4.3889 and gold up 0.8089. Off: high-yield OAS at 3.34 and copper up 1.4149, since copper_down needs a decline.

High-yield OAS at 3.34 sits at the 83.67 percentile and carries 6.6936 points on a weight of 10, the heaviest single weight in the model. It tightened from 3.42 and is 0.66 below the 4.0 trigger, which makes credit the cheapest falsifier of the risk_off read.

VIX at 19.92 scores 67.06 at a weight of 8 for 5.3648 points, down from 25.64. Realized volatility is 22.047, so the options market prices less stress than the level model reads, and the volatility dimension at 61.01 is the softest of the six.

Breadth above the 200 day average is 0.3226, 50 of 155 names, scoring 82.74 at a weight of 7 for 5.0363 points. It is 0.0274 below the 0.35 risk_off gate and it is the only limb holding the regime there, since VIX at 19.92 is far from 28.

The ten year real rate at 2.66 sits at the 98.16 percentile, the highest percentile of any input, and contributes 4.908 on a weight of 5. It rose from 2.63 and is why the macro dimension edged up to 74.6 from 73.74.

supporting_signals.claim: All 22 sector and theme rows reproduce: 21 rebuild exactly from the cache with the production chaining function, and the remaining row, auto, is a single-leg basket whose 0.4576 is TSLA's own return. The 6 ETF proxies SKYY, CIBR, IGV, SOXX, FDN and ESPO match their own series to 4 decimals.
China closed with all 11 names higher, a mean of 5.0545 and a median of 5.2067, the weakest at 2.9751, the widest one-day advance in the tracked window.

Credit improved on the same vintage: high-yield OAS fell to 3.34 from 3.42 and investment grade to 0.91 from 0.93, while the dollar index at 121.8803 is only 0.3742 above its 2026-11-06 level of 121.5061.

contradicting_signals.claim: The premarket rebound is not in this layer. CNBC and Investing.com relays put NVDA up 5 and AMD up more than 6 percent before the open after CoreWeave lifted its revenue outlook, but the fact layer's NVDA at 168.889999 is the 2026-11-10 close and carries 5.4738 of decline, so the reversal can only be confirmed by the next layer.

The volatility market disagrees with the level model. VIX at 19.92 is below 20 and 8.08 under the 28 crisis limb, realized volatility is 22.047 and the volatility dimension contributes only 61.01, so 69.11 is being held up by levels, not by stress.

The 4.4664 memory row cuts against the AI hardware liquidation story: it is a Korean session print, SK Hynix at 5.363 and Samsung at 3.5696, and it excludes MU at 1.0966 by construction. The two signals are not comparable.

what_changed_today: Total risk 69.11 against 69.14 on 2026-11-10, a 0.03 decline, with the weekly change at 6.09 and the monthly at 14.42, both still positive.

The 2026-11-09 Treasury close entered the model and accounts for the only positive contribution, 0.172: the curve narrowed to 0.32 from 0.35, the real rate rose to 2.66 from 2.63 and the ten year to 4.88 from 4.86.
Equity structure gave back 0.180 as breadth improved to 0.3226 from 0.3097 and the new low ratio fell to 0.0382, and trend gave back 0.016; volatility and cross-asset were unchanged.

The label readers saw yesterday was late_cycle at 68.58 on the 12:36Z generation, while the settled 2026-11-10 row is 69.14 and risk_off, so today's risk_off continues the settled series rather than marking a fresh downgrade.
China is back on the current session: the 2026-11-11 close covers all 11 names, where the 2026-11-10 brief could only cite the 2026-11-09 session because every new bar arrived with a null close.
The three mixed baskets re-pointed at Asia on their last step: memory took the Korean 2026-11-11 session on 2 of 8 legs, consumer_electronics 2 of 10, and robotics a single leg.
watch_next: PPI lands on 2026-11-13T13:30Z, the only high-importance release this week, and the fact layer carries no forecast, so its impact cannot be sized in advance.
NVDA reports on 2026-11-17 against a forecast of 2.47; the stock has already paid 26.094 of one-month decline and semiconductor relative strength is 16.6242 on a 63 session window.
The nearest event is CSCO on 2026-11-12 with a forecast of 1.33, medium importance, and it is the last risk appetite read before the 2026-11-13 inflation print.

The CPI gap is still open: the 3.71725 in this layer is the 2026-09 vintage and the October print released on 2026-11-10 has not been ingested; the next official update is Personal Income and Outlays plus GDP on 2026-11-25T13:30Z.
Breadth at 0.3226 needs 0.0274 to clear 0.35, and if it does while VIX holds 19.92 both risk_off limbs fail at once.
Whether Korea's memory bid extends the 5.363 and 3.5696 of 2026-11-11 is the fastest test of whether the AI hardware split is rotation or a top.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth clears 0.35 and the level dimensions roll over
points: Breadth needs just 0.0274 to clear the 0.35 gate; with VIX at 19.92 the regime would leave risk_off and the total would lose the cross-asset 11.25 and part of the breadth 5.0363.
High-yield OAS at 3.34 is 0.66 from the 4.0 trigger and tightening, so the credit limb is not adding pressure.
All 11 China names advancing at a mean of 5.0545, plus Korea's 5.363 and 3.5696, suggest the hardware cycle is rotating rather than breaking.

base_case.title: Base case: 68 to 71 while the level dimensions hold
points: The six dimensions are level driven: liquidity and credit 74.21, macro 74.6 and cross-asset 75.0 carry the bulk, and none of them moves without a new print.
A weekly change of 6.09 and a monthly 14.42 mean the model has drifted up for a month, and today's 0.03 is noise inside that drift.
The next scheduled repricing point is PPI on 2026-11-13T13:30Z.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the volatility limb re-prices and breadth breaks below 0.28
points: If VIX returns above 28 the volatility dimension would climb from 61.01 toward full score, enough at a weight of 15 to push the total from 69.11 past 71 with no change in price; VIX at 19.92 is only 8.08 below that line.
Breadth is already the binding constraint: a slide from 0.3226 toward 0.28 with the new low ratio at 0.0382 widening would turn equity structure at 67.82 into a drag again.
There is no buffer between NVDA's 18.2883 weekly decline and the 2.47 forecast due 2026-11-17, and a miss lands directly on the 16.6242 measured over 63 sessions.
